This [[Mandallian Giant]] '''assassin''' was a criminal living on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. He pretended to be a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to fool [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] whom he intended to kill. Vos, with the aid of [[Vilmarh Grahrk]], saw through his disguise and killed him with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|These guys I know. Them not Jedi. Them Bad Boys.|[[Vilmarh Grahrk]], referring to the Jedi imposter and his partner|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 19">[[Star Wars (1998) 19|''Star Wars'' (1998) 19]]</ref>}}
The [[Mandallian Giant]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] was one of many beings on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] who in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]] placed bets on how long the Jedi [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] would survive after his memory was wiped with an overdose of [[glitteryll]]. To try to make sure he and his [[Unidentified Gotal assassin|Gotal partner]] won the bet, he acquired Quinlan Vos's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and a set of robes similar to a Jedi's. They used these to pretended to be Jedi to fool Vos into trusting them so that they could more easily kill him at the time they had bet on his death taking place. However the criminal [[Vilmarh Grahrk]] recognized the pair and told Vos they were merely other [[Gambling/Legends|gamblers]] attempting to cheat. This angered the pair and they attacked Vos and Grahrk. The Mandallin Giant charged first but was shot in the shoulder by Vos and killed. Vos then used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to retrieve his lightsaber from the fallen criminal.
